rooms.name: The Entrance
rooms.desc:
You are at the entrance to the Kir Drax'in Zoo. All sorts of creatures have
been captured and placed in artificially created biomes so that visitors can
see creatures as they are in the wild. The room opens up to the north where
there is a lot of commotion going on.

rooms.name: The Zoo
rooms.desc:
You are in a large room with a wooden podium in the middle.
There are exits in all four major directions.  A large sign
displays information about all the attractions at the Zoo.

rooms.name: The Zoo
rooms.desc:
You are standing at the start of the west wing. Loud shrieks and screams emanate
from the room north of here, while the south is strangely quiet.

rooms.name: Malchor's Monkey World
rooms.desc:
This room looks like a tornado has gone through it, a tree has been knocked
over to allow more things for the monkeys to climb on, branches are strewn
about the floor, and piles of feces are cumulating in the corners.

rooms.name: Lyratha's House of Lizards
rooms.desc:
This room is very creepy, the magically created light is dimmed to simulate
nighttime, and vines hang down from the ceiling. The floor is covered with
leaves and sprinkled with dirt. A few hollowed out logs make room for the
inhabitants of the room to sleep and play around in.

rooms.name: The Zoo
rooms.desc:
You are in the west wing of the zoo. To the north lies Haerund's Hyena Haven
and to the south is Blazidon's Badger Paradise.

rooms.name: Haerund's Hyena Haven
rooms.desc:
The floor of this room is covered in sand, and the corpse of a cow lies in
the middle of the floor, rotting and causing a distinct odor. In the northeast
corner of the room is a small pool of water.

rooms.name: Blazidon's Badger Paradise
rooms.desc:
The ground here is dirt, with mounds piled up where the badgers have dug their
burrows. A tree with long, curling roots gives them places to hide in the
shade of their artificial sun.

rooms.name: The Zoo
rooms.desc:
You are  in the west wing of the Kir Drax'in Zoo. To the north lies Banadar's
Bear Bungalow, and to the south is Wally's Wolverine Farm.

rooms.name: Banadar's Bear Bungalow
rooms.desc:
This room was constructed to look like the inside of a large cave
complete with stalactites and talagmites.  There are a few large
boulders lying around, and a sign is posted on one of them.

rooms.name: Wally's Wolverine Farm
rooms.desc:
This room is made up to look like a subarctic forest. A thin layer of snow
covers the ground, and some tall, leafless trees litter the landscape. In the
back of the room is a small cave, not large enough for a human to fit in.

rooms.name: The Zoo
rooms.desc:
You are at the end of the west wing. To the west is Pizentios' Pachyderm
Playground. To the south is Trunnian's Tiger Hut, and to the north is
Regnet's Rhino Emporium.

rooms.name: Regnet's Rhino Emporium
rooms.desc:
The ground in this room is dusty, but you can see some lush greenery growing
near a large pool of clear water. The artificial sun beats down upon you
mercilessly, the creator of this place must have been very skilled, and you
contemplate standing under one of the few trees scattered about.

rooms.name: Trunnian's Tiger Hut
rooms.desc:
You are in a room designed to be a thick, jungle-like biome. Bamboo shoots
sprout out all over, and the ground is soft and loamy.

rooms.name: Pizentios' Pachyderm Playground
rooms.desc:
This room is fashioned out to be a grassland. The hard, dusty ground sprouts
tufts of grass all over, and a tree droops over a pool of clean water. Another
pool of water, muddy and brackish stands several yards away from the clean one.

rooms.name: The Zoo
rooms.desc:
Through the door to your north is the aviary, where all types of birds live. To
the south is the main room, from which you can leave the zoo or enter another
wing.

rooms.name: The Aviary
rooms.desc:
You are in the southwest corner of the aviary. Many different forms of
vegetation are grown here, giving the birds food and shelter. Small puddles
of water dot the soft dirt.

rooms.name: The Aviary
rooms.desc:
You are in the southern part of the aviary, where the zoo keeps all the birds
and vegetation. Strange plants grow here, amongst tall trees that keep the
low areas shaded from the artificial sun.

rooms.name: The Aviary
rooms.desc:
You are in the southeast corner of the aviary, where the zoo keeps its birds,
bird-like creatures, and exotic vegetation. Strange trees grow here, with long,
curling roots sucking up all the water.

rooms.name: The Aviary
rooms.desc:
You are in the western part of the aviary. Small forms fly high above you,
above even the tall trees looming all around. A large pool of water stands in
a circle of jagged stones.

rooms.name: The Aviary
rooms.desc:
You are in the center of the aviary. You can hear the songs of many different
birds, making beautiful music. Something moves among the plants nearby and
you get the feeling you shouldn't stand around for too long.

rooms.name: The Aviary
rooms.desc:
You are in the eastern portion of the aviary. All different sorts of flowers
grow here, filling the air with their scents.

rooms.name: The Aviary
rooms.desc:
You are in the northwest part of the aviary. Your feet are partially submerged
in a small pond, and you notice little fish swimming away from the ripples you
create with your movements.

rooms.name: The Aviary
rooms.desc:
You are in the northern portion of the aviary. Small birds hop on the leaves
of giant plants as you approach, some flying away with chirps of anger.

rooms.name: The Aviary
rooms.desc:
You are in the northeast part of the aviary. The ground here is desert-like and
the plant life consists mainly of cacti of all sizes.

rooms.name: The Zoo
rooms.desc:
This is where the zookeepers keep the more exotic creatures. There are animal
pens to the north and south.

rooms.name: The Zaivrag Chamber
rooms.desc:
This room is designed to look like some sort of mountainous territory, and
your footing isn't very stable. You can see a big nest several yards away from
your current position.

rooms.name: The Maaralis Chamber
rooms.desc:
This room is meant to be a marsh biome. The whole area lets off a dreary aura
with its low-hanging moss-covered half-dead trees.

rooms.name: The Zoo
rooms.desc:
This is the end of the east wing, which contains exotic beasts. There are pens
in all directions, except west which leads back to the center of the zoo.

rooms.name: The Steel Slug Chamber
rooms.desc:
This room is made out to be the inside of a cave, a thin film of moisture seems
to cover every surface. A small pool of water stands in the far corner.

rooms.name: The Torewe Chamber
rooms.desc:
This room is designed like a forest, with trees and bushes everywhere. The sun
is almost set and it isn't too bright here.

rooms.name: The Nark Chamber
rooms.desc:
This room was created like a desert, with sand, cacti and everything. There
are a few rock outcroppings, but no major obstructions in the horizon.
